subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned persistent facts be a scoped core Memory/Agents UI feature, folded into the broader memory-files panel, or deferred until plugin Control UI contribution slots exist?
rationale: Current code has only whole-file editing and memory routing; choosing storage, injection guarantees, freshness labels, and browser write security is a product/security decision rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Define scoped core pinned facts
options.body: Create a narrow core contract for pinned facts with explicit storage, audit/diff, authz, and injection semantics before implementation.

options.title: Fold into the memory panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as a structured sub-mode of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory editor tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46809.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI slots
options.body: Keep this as a memory/context plugin use case until the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Define scoped core pinned facts
recommendation.body: Create a narrow core contract for pinned facts with explicit storage, audit/diff, authz, and injection semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The direct implementation boundary is the Agents dashboard and file-editing surface introduced by gumadeiras, with memory and plugin-slot owners as reviewers.
